title: Modular A/V: Vines theme
description: Frames of woven branches and ivy for the cameras of the Modular A/V dock: the ivy grows from the corner each one sits in, turns to autumn while its player is muted, and the picture glows while they speak. Best with the scattered layout.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player
